tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /slob dpon spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus kha skong dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed byung tshul bzhugs/
༄༅/ /slob dpon spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus kha skong dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed byung tshul bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus kha skong dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed byung tshul bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ slob dpon tsar+ya pa chen po'i gtam rgyud kyi skabs su gol sa gcod pa dang nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bshad na/ slob dpon chen po de nyid kyi skabs nas gzung rjes su lo brgya'am nyis brgya'i bar mtshams tshun chad du slob dpon nyid kyi rjes 'brang dang*/ rjes 'brang slob rgyud ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzhan yang rung ste/ dbang po rnon po rdzogs rim kho na bsgoms pas ye shes mchog skyes pa/ 'bring po bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar la bslabs pas rim pas brtan pa thob pa dang*/ tha ma bskyed rim tsam la brtan pa thob pa shin tu mang bar byung zhing*/ phal cher slob dpon spyod pa pa chen po'i mig ltos la brten nas/ spros bcas sam spros med kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa'i srol ka mang po dang*/ dus la ma bab pa ci rigs tsam ma gtogs/ spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang rung re thob pa kho na'o/ khyad par du yang slob dpon chen po kah+na pa'i slob rgyud ches mang zhing*/ de dag rnams rim gnyis la rtogs pa skyes shing*/ cung zad brtan na shin tu brtan pa rang ma thob kyang*/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa'i srol ka shin tu dar zhing*/ thams cad la 'dod don grub 'bras kyang 'byung ste/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i dus la bab pa gcig dang*/ slob dpon kah+na pa nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi stobs kyang yin par grags/ de yang slob dpon des brtul zhugs kyi 'phro bsdus nas/ rang gi mdzad dgos rgyu'i bya ba lhag ma rnams/ slob rgyud rnams kyi don du bsngos pa las byung ba yin zer/ dus de tsam na spyod pa pa'i slob rgyud phyogs kun tu khyab la/ dus tshod de'i rjes shig nas tsar+ya pa'i sde shar phyogs su gtso bor dar bas/ bar skabs der 'phag yul gyi kha skad la/ shar phyogs nag po pas 'dul bas tsar+ya pa mang*/

lho phyogs klu sgrub kyis 'dul bas dharma pa mang*/ nub phyogs lā ba pas 'dul bas ba lan+ti pa mang*/ byang phyogs go rak+ṣas 'dul bas a te sa pa mang zer te phyi ma 'di da lta dzo gir grags pa rnams so/ /tsar+ya pa'i sde la grub thob che chung dpag tu med pa byung*/ da lta yang bhang ga la dang bhā ṭi dang*/ her m+ba dang*/ sil ha ṭa dang*/ ko ki sogs na sde cung zad tsam yod de/ mi grangs mang po med kyang dus la ltos pa'i nus pa thob pa mang po yod do/ /sngon bod kyi lo rgyus gzhan rnams na'ang sna tshogs snang zhing*/ do ha'i ngag sgros ras chung pa nas brgyud pa/ rje rgya ras kyis yi ger mdzad pa cig na/ bla ma'i bka' chad byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i nag po pa de/ nag po spyod pa chung ba yin/ che ba min gsung ba cig kyang 'dug de yang ti pu'am/ a mo gha badz+ra gyi gsung bgros cig ni yin par snang*/ u rgyan pa rin chen dpal yang de dang mthun par gsung zhing*/ khong rang nag po pa'i rnam 'phrul yin tshul slob ma rnams kyis bris 'dug khong gis mdzad pa'i gtan tshigs nyung ngu cig na/ rgya gar ba rnams slob dpon nag po spyod pa da lta kam+po dza'i gling na 'khrungs yod/ ma 'ongs pa na ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub mang po sgrubs te/ wā rā ṇa sir byon nas chos bstan pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ches dar te/ grub thob gnam gyi skar ma tsam 'byung bar 'dod do/ /zhes bris 'dug yi ge de na rgyal po go pā las 'grub pa'i yi dam yang lha mo tsun da yin par bshad pa dang*/ skabs 'di'i 'dod tshul bskyar ba de gnyis rgya gar ba'i ngag sgros su 'dug /bod rkyang pa'i rig gras dang mi 'dra'o/ /rgya gar phyogs na'i slob rgyud bod pa rnams kyi do ha'i lo rgyus kun na/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa yang*/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul yin par 'chad cing*/ 'bar ba'i gtso bo nag po spyod pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'chad do/

/yang ji skad du/ brtul zhugs spyod 'chang bla med pa/ /'bar ba'i gtso bo'i bka' drin gyis/ /zhes slob dpon a mi ta badz+ra gyis bshad/ dpyad de mig zur la thogs nas phyis kyi kha cig spyod 'chang nag po dang*/ 'bar gtso gcig yin/ de dang nag po spyod pa tha dad do zhes smra ba ni/ gling chen ras pa dang*/ gling ras mi gcig zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /yang 'bar ba'i gtso bo'i skye ba gsal bar dran pas spyod pa nyid la'ang 'bar ba'i gtso bo'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'byung ba ni mi 'gal lo/ /da ni gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig brjod de/ tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa kā li zer ba cig yul ra dha'i tshong 'dus dang nye bar sgom byed do/ /de'i grogs mched bi kā li zer ba cig grong khyer li khar shing 'phel dang nye bar bsgom mo/ /gnyis kar gyis ting nge 'dzin cung zad brnyes/ bi kā li grong khyer ra dhar song na/ ka li dang 'phrad/ 'o skol rnams tshogs 'khor bya'o zhes bgros nas/ tshogs khang du rnal 'byor pho mo gzhan yang spyan drangs/ bi kā li na re/ dur khrod nas mi ro bkug la gdan bya zer/ khong gnyis kar dur khrod du phyin/ mi ro rnams la lcag rgyab pas thams cad langs te/ tshogs khang du sleb nas so so'i gdan dgos par 'gyel te song ngo*/ /der g.yas gral gyi 'go la bi kā li dang*/ g.yon gral gyi 'go la kā li 'dug nas tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba byas/ de grol ba na thams cad langs pa'i skabs/ da mi ro rnams rang gnas su skyel dgos zer tsa na/ kā li'i 'gral gyi rnams la/ khong rang gis se gol gtogs pas thams cad langs nas gar byed cing dur khrod du song*/ sngar gyi shul du 'gyel lo/ /bi kā li'i gral gyi/ rnams khong rang gi dmigs pa brtad cing rnam 'gyur byas pas/ thog mar phyed tsam langs te slar 'gyel/ bar du mgo bteg tsam bteg tsam byung*/ mthar 'gul ba tsam yang ma byung ste/ der rnal 'byor pa kā lin re/

nus pa cung zad tsam la nga rgyal byar mi rung*/ da dung bsgom dgos zer/ mi ro de rnams la kā lis rdog pa re bsnun pas thams cad langs te snga ma bzhin du song ngo*/ /phyis rnal 'byor pa kā lis dngos grub chen po brnyes/ bi kā lis kyang slar rang gnas su log ste bsgoms/ dus gzhan cig na mig sman gyi dngos grub thob bo/ /yang rgyal po de ba bā li'i yig mkhan pra ṇa pa zhes bya ba zhigayig mkhan bor te chos bslabs pas paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas par song*/ de nas tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig gi drung du phyin nas gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes/ lus kyang shin tu yang ba thob ste ngal dub med par gyur cing*/ chu'i steng du 'chag par nus/ nang gi rtsa thig mthong pa'i nus pas/ bstan bcos dang yi ge'i rigs sngar ma shes pa thams cad kyang shes/ dud 'gro dang mi ma yin gyi skad go bar byung*/ da ni nus pa thob pas spyod pa bya'am snyam ste lan cig ljongs rgyu zhing song ngo*/ /der yul kā ma ru'i grong khyer cig gi 'dabs na/ lha khang phyed tsam zhig pa cig 'dug/de na gsung rab klog pa'i sgra thos so/ /sgo phye nas nang du phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa kun spangs kyi cha byad rgan po cigares 'ga' ni po ti klogares 'ga' ni gnyid yur zhing 'dug go /de dang gtam cung zad byas nas/ pra ṇa pas klog mkhan de la/ khyed paṇ+ḍi ta lags sam rnal 'byor pa lags byas pas/ de na re/ rnal 'byor pa yin zer/ rnal 'byor pa rgan po zhig klog 'don byed dam byas pas/ 'di klog pa shin tu dka' bas dka' thub tu 'gyur sdig pa 'byang snyam klog pa yin zer/ de tsam klog pa la dka' ba ci yod byas pas/ de na re/ 'o na khyed rang 'di klog nga sgom pa la 'gro zer/ po ti de gtad nas de song ngo*/ /pra ṇa pas der po ti bltas pas yi ge'i 'go gzhug tsam yang ngo ma shes/ rnal 'byor pa de yang gar song cha med do/

/der spyod pa bya ba'i dus la ma sleb/ da dung sgoms shig ces pa'i sgra nam mkha' nas sgrags pas/ yang de nags tshal dben pa zhig tu song nas bsgoms so/ /klog mkhan gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa de ni/ grub thob dharma pa yin par grags/ rnal 'byor pa pra ṇa pas phyis spros bcas kyi spyod pa ni ma byas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshig gi bdag po'i dngos grub 'grub ste smon lam gang btab pa 'grub bo/ /yang tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig mtsho zhig gi 'gram na sgom zhing yod do/ /yul ni u ḍi bi sha yin/ der lan cig tho rangs kha sgra dang 'od chen po dang bcas te/ bud med nag mo cig gam du byung ngo*/ /de bkres so/ /skoms so/ /ngal lo zer ba la/ rnal 'byor pa de la ri khrod pa 'gas byin pa'i ma he'i gzug gcig dang*/ chang gha ṭa gang yod pa dang stabs 'grig nas/ de la byin pas/ de khams gcig la zos/ hub gcig la btungs/ de dga' ba'i tshul gyis sngags cig bslabs/ 'dis lta stangs bcu 'grub par 'gyur zer/ bud med de na re/ nged phra men ma'i lugs kyis sngags gzhan la sbyin nas lus 'dor dgos zer/ mtsho de'i dbus su nub song skad/ rnal 'byor pa des rtsa shing la nyams sad byas pas/ lta stangs grub par mngon te/ da ni yul rgyu zhing spyod pa bya snyam/ de nas cung zad cig yul gzhan du song ba na/ blon po'i bu mo zhig blon po gzhan cig la bag mar 'gro ba la/ rgyang ring po nas dbang gi lta stangs byas pas/ de dpon g.yog thams cad tshur 'ongs rnal 'byor pa la phyag btsal/ gser gyi phye mas gtor/ yo byad rnam pa du ma bzhag nas song ngo*/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa de don thams cad 'grub snyam dga' ches te/ rig pa yer yer por byas nas rgyu zhing song ngo*/ /de nas dus gzhan cig na/ thong mkhan zhig zhing rmo zhing 'dug /pha tshad na bza' btung sna tshogs pa ras kyis g.yogs te bzhag 'dug go

/da lto'i dus la bab pas zas slong dgos snyam ste/ shis brjod byas pas/ thong mkhan de ni gtam gyi sne tsam yang mi len par ma thos pa bzhin du lan mi 'debs/ rgyab bstan cing 'gro'o/ /de nas yang nan gyis lto bslangs pas rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs bzung nas ltogs ngab che ba 'di 'dra zhes kha zer bas/ des kyang rmos glang gnyis la lta stangs byas pas/ glang gnyis de ma thag shi'o/ /der thong mkhan na re/ 'o na khyod sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor par 'dug pa/ sangs rgyas pa snying rje can bya ba yin/ da glang 'di gnyis gso bar zhu zer/ der rnal 'byor pas sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin byas kyang*/ g.yo ba tsam yang ma byung ngo*/ /der thong mkhan nyid kyis lcag rgyab pas glang gnyis 'phrab cing langs/ zhing chen po de yang skad cig nyid la rmos grub ste/ thag je ring je ring la mig mthong tsam nas/ de na re/ sems can la phan btags pas dngos grub thob pa yin gyi/ ngan pa'i spyod pas ga la yin/ da dung sgoms shig zer nas mi snang bar song ngo*/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro mas mchog sbyin pa de ni yang dag pa'i dngos grub kyi bar chad du shes nas lhag pa'i lha la nan tan du bshags pa byas nas bsgoms pas/ nam zhig na bcom ldan 'das ma 'dab chags kyi gzugs kyi rnam pas byon nas/ lung bstan zhing byin gyis brlabs/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros can du gyur/ phra mo'i las rnams ni grub lus ni gnas ma gyur ro/ /'dis dang po zhig rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dga' ston dang tshogs kyi skabs/ gral 'chos mkhan yun ring rab byas pas/ pang ka ti pa ste gral bcos pa zhes ming la grags so/ /thong mkhan du snang ba de yang grub thob me dhi na pa yin par grags kyi/ dpal he ru ka'i gsal kha med do/ /yang slob dpon shrī ma nu ni/ yul ma rur 'khrungs/ rigs tshong pa/ gnas de nyid du rab tu byung nas mi ring bar kha che'i yul du song*/

der rin sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang du sde snod gsum la sbyangs shing mkhas par byas pa zhig /slob dpon spyod pa pa'i dngos slob rnal 'byor pa nan+dhi pa zhes bya ba sa 'og gi 'jig rten du 'gro nus pa cig dang mjal/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa thob/ dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su brag phug gcig tu gnas bcas te bsgom zhing bzhugs/ dpyid kyi thig le la gsal snang thob pas/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul shugs la byung ste/ ri'i khong seng dang sa 'og la ci bder spyod nus/ de nas nus pa cung zad thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig tu rig brtul gyi spyod pas yul rgyu zhing song ba na/ grong khyer cig gi 'dabs na thags mkhan rgad po gcig 'dug go /de na re khyod rnams rnal 'byor par rlom pa zhig 'dug na/ dur khrod du tshogs 'khor la mi 'gro'am zer/ 'gro'o byas nas lhan cig tu song*/ mi gzhon nu tsho bcud dang ldan pa'i ro zhig blangs te tshogs rdzas la bzhag pa na/ shrī ma nu 'khor bcas kyis mtshon gyis gcod par brtsams pa la/ thags mkhan de na re/ khyed rnams dngos grub kyi rdzas la sdig pa gsog gam zhes gad mo byed do/ /'o na ji ltar bza' byas pas/ thags mkhan de stag chen po'i gzugs su byas nas/ khams cig la zos nas slar mir song ngo*/ /de na re/ deng 'dir rdzas kyi dngos grub la/ khyod rnams g.yel bar gyur gy-i/ da ni dngos grub phra mo don du mi gnyer bar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgoms shig zer ro/ /de nas shrī ma nus kyang spros pa spangs te lo bcu gnyis bsgoms/ der dngos grub chen po nyams 'og tu chud nas slob ma 'ga' la chos bstan/ yul la hor du grong khyer gyi lam 'gegs pa'i brag de'u cig chu klung nī la'i 'gram du bskyal bas/ sdig spyod kla klo'i rgyal po zhig kyang dad pa thob ste zhabs la gtugs/ 'di mthar sku lus mi snang bar gyur ro/

/de ltar bzhi po de rnams la tsa tur a bhi ma n+ya sā dha ka ste/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gyi sgrub pa po bzhi zer ro/ /bod rnying rnams kyang*/ gtam rgyud de dag gi dum bu 'dra/ slob dpon kah+na pa chen po la sbyor ba 'di ni/ de bzhi kar tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ tsar+ya pa zer tsa na slob dpon kah+na pa yin te 'ong snyam pa cig gis/ bal po'i sngags pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ bod rnying pa rnams la 'khrul gzhi bskyed pas byung 'dra'o/ /bshad ma thag pa'i thags mkhan rgan po de ni/ grub thob tan+di pa yin te de yang*/ yul mā la bar thags mkhan zhig thags 'thags pa'i las la mkhas shing rtsol ba che ba cig yod do/ /de la bu yang bcu tsam byung zhing*/ phyis de dag chen por gyur nas re re zhing khyim phug bag ma blangs/ so so la yang bu tsha mang du btsas thags mkhan gyi rigs rgyud shin tu mang bar gyur to/ /de nas de shin tu rgas par gyur te/ bu rnams kyi khyim du re mos kyis gso ba las/ de rgas pas sbyor ba mi bzo zhing*/ spyod pa mi mdzes par mthong nas/ bu rnams na re/ pha la 'o mi brgyal ba'i zhabs tog ni nged rnams kyis byed/ khyim du re mos 'byon pa khyed rang 'o brgyal/ mi rnams kyis kyang 'phya ba las mi 'dug pas/ 'dir bzhugs shig zer bu rgan shos kyi khyim dang nye ba'i skyed mos tshal cig du bzhag 'tsho ba re mos kyis skyel lo/ /lan cig grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa de thags mkhan de'i bu cig gi khyim du byon pa/ nam sros pa na skyed mos tshal der gnas g.yar ba'i tshul gyis bskyal lo/ /der sgron me dang bcas te mi zhig sleb song ba ni shes/ su yin ma shes pa la/ tho rangs kyi dus tsa na thags mkhan rgan pos de na yod pa de su yin zhes dris pas/ dngos phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig lags/ nyid rang su yin gsung*/ bdag thags mkhan 'di kun gyi pha lags te/ gzhan la ston ma nyan par 'dir sbas pa yin pas/

rang gis rang la yi chad pas yid mi bde bar mchis zer/ 'o na sdug bsngal de sel ba'i thabs cig mi 'tshal lam gsungs pas/ cis kyang 'tshal gyi rjes su gzung bar zhu zer/ de la slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pas rgan po de la ye shes 'pho bar mdzad de rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal lo/ /de yang sems kyi sdug bsngal sangs/ nom pa chen po rnyed pa bzhin du spro ba bskyed de bsgoms pas/ le gnyis sam gsum tsam lon pa'i skabs shig na/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud de/ 'on kyang re zhig gzhan la ma bstan par sbas te 'dug go /lan cig bu che shos de'i zas skyel ba'i res cig la/ nyin par mgron po byung ba sogs bya bas g.yengs nas/ zan skyel ba brjed/ nam phyed na dran te g.yog po zhig zas skyel du btang bas/ skyed mos tshal ni 'od kyis khyab/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs 'dug ste/ sgo gseng nas bltas pas rgan po de ni lus la 'od 'phro zhing*/ gzugs dang cha byad sna tshogs pa'i mi ma yin gzi brjid dang ldan pas mchod pa byed par mthong ngo*/ /de nas grub pa thob pa'i grags pa byung bas yul der ma bzhugs/ yul gzhan sna tshogs par thags mkhan gyi spyod par brdzus te/ lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas mthar 'khor mang po dang bcas te mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /grub thob tan+ti pa 'di ni barbi/ ḍom+bi sogs dang 'dra ba'i grub thob ches che ba zhig yin par 'dug 'dis gsungs pa'i do ha sum brgya pa bya ba rgyas pa cig yod/ gzhan yang man ngag thor bu mang du mdzad yod par 'dug na'ang*/ gtam rgyud de tsam kho na ma gtogs/ 'gro don mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus rgyas pa ni bdag gis ma rnyed do/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ sngon theg pa chen po'i gsung rab 'jig rten du thog mar byon pa'i skabs/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud phal cher byon par snang zhing*/

'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor bla med kyang mang du byung ba'i sdebs la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di yang byon pa yin no/ /sngar bod gzhan rnams 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa rgyud 'di sus spyan drangs pa'i gsal kha mi smra la/ mar do ni sam+bhu ṭi dang lhan cig slob dpon spyod pa pas spyan drangs par bzhed mod/ snga ma nyid don la gnas so/ /de ltar rgyud 'di byon pa nas ring zhig gi bar du gsang sngags 'dzin pa rnams kyis bsgoms shing bshad nas dngos grub thob pa mtha' yas pa byung mod kyang*/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ring du dar ba med la/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos brtsams pa yang cher med/ de'i phyir de dag gi gtam rgyud kyang nub pa kho na'o/ /des na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sa ra ha pa klu sgrub ces sogs brgyud pa 'dod pa yang rnam grangs tsam yin gyi/ gcig tu nges bzung can yang med do/ /de nas phyi zhig na grub thob shā ba ri pas/ sdom pa'i rgyud kyi don thugs su chud nas dpal lū yi pa la thog mar gdams pa yin mod/ phyis ni slob dpon lū yi pa de nyid sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bdag por gyur cing*/ dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo nyid kyis rtag tu mngon sum du 'doms pa yin pas/ lū yi pa'i gong du gzhan la brgyud pa 'ded mi dgos so/ /slob dpon 'dis dpal rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud spyan drangs par grags/ de'i rjes su slob dpon rdo rje dril bu bas kyang*/ dpal mngon spyod bla ma'i rgyud spyan drangs par 'chad pa'ang yod/ gang ltar na yang slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis bshad rgyud de dag dang bstun nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi sgrub thabs sogs bstan bcos mdzad do/ /slob dpon lū dril nag gsum po 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed nyi zla lta bur grags pa yin la/ gzhan yang dā ri ka pa dang*/

ḍing gi pa dang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba rnams kyis lam srol re phye zhing*/ slob dpon kong ka na pa'am/ lang ka rgyal bzang dang*/ mi thub zla ba dang*/ bha ba bha dra rnams kyis kyang lugs srol mi 'dra ba re mdzad 'dug bram ze rin chen rdo rjes kyang de dag dang mi 'dra ba'i lugs srol gsar ba mdzad 'dug pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba'i rjes 'brang yin nam khong rang nyid kyis srol gsar du phye ba yin brtag par bya mod lugs srol ngo mtshar che zhing byin rlabs dang ldan pa cig ni yin par snang ngo*/ /rin chen rdo rjes bde mchog gi sgrub thabs 'di kha che'i yul du brtsams nas/ yul dbus su dpal nā ro pa la skyes su stsal bas/ nā ro pas gzigs te ngo mtshar che bar dgongs nas/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags nas/ phyag mchod rgya cher mdzad pas/ snyan grags rgyas te ji zhig ltar la kha che dang nyi 'og tu/ dpal lū yi pa'i lugs las kyang 'di sgom pa mang ba'i dus cig byung skad/ bod du yang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rtsal 'don du bsgyur zhing*/ sngon dus cung zad dar bas sa bcad mchan bu yig sna sogs yod do/ /lang ka rgyal bzang gi lugs ni 'ga' zhig lū yi pa'i nang sel yin zer ro/ /'on kyang bskyed rim lū yi pa dang mthun rung du yod kyang*/ rdzogs rim sogs sgo gzhan nas ches mi 'dra bas lugs srol logs pa nyid yin no/ /de dag ni bod du 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas so/ /gzhan yang grub thob glu dbyangs mkhan dang*/ nag po rdo rje dang*/ ka la hang sa ku mā ra dang*/ dharma pa dang*/ kuk+ku ṭi pa dang*/ ghun+ṭa ri pa dang*/ tsa ṭi ya pa dang*/ nā ḍi pa dang*/ ghan+dha ra pa dang*/ bī na pa dang*/ ṭan+ṭen pa dang*/ tā ḍa ka ba dang*/ kaṃ ka la pa dang*/ dza ya nan+di pa dang*/ bha de pa ste grub pa'i slob dpon bcu bzhi po de dag kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam las grub pa brnyes shing*/ de dag gi srol gtod pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sogs lugs srol mi 'dra ba re re byung bar grags/

so so'i dus der lugs de dang de bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung bar 'dug /de dag gis mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bod du 'gyur ba mang po mi snang yang*/ 'phags pa'i yul du sngon dus mang du byung zhing*/ phyis kyang ci rigs pa yod par snang ngo*/ /rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la lha tshogs thams cad sku mdog nag por 'dod pa yod ces bshad pa ni/ slob dpon dharma pa'i lugs yin par snang la/ zhabs g.yon brkyang du mdzad pa yod par bshad pa ni nag po rdo rje'i sgrub thabs so/ /gar stabs su byed pa ni grub thob sa 'dzin zhabs te gan+dhar pa'i lugs so/ /grub thob ghun+ṭa ri pa'i slob ma dpal o rgyan par grags pa chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sku mdog ma nges par 'dod cing*/ yab yum kha dog rnam pa kun tu mtshungs par smra'o/ /bī na pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs na/ lha tshogs thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par yod pas/ de'i lugs la rtsa rgyud kyi lha tshogs phyag gnyis pa kho nar bzhed ces grags kyang*/ sgom bde ba'i dgos pa dang mtshon byed tsam yin gyi/ phyag mangs mi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng du bsdus pa'i/ he ru ka ser po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ slob dpon dza ya nan ti pa'i lugs yin zer ba tsam snang*/ slob dpon bha de pa dang*/ bha da li ka dang*/ bha dra pa dang*/ ban+dhe pa rnams mtshan 'dra mtshungs la/ yi ge nor ba dang*/ don nor ba dang*/ gcig tu 'khrul ba mang po byung yang ngo bo so so yin zhing*/ bstan bcos kyang so sor yod do/ /slob dpon kuk+ku ṭi pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad gdong brnyan can du bzhed ces grags so/ /de la grub thob glu dbyangs mkhan ni/ glu gar mkhan gyi rigs rang gi las la brtson pa/ tshig mang po gsar du sbyor nus pa zhig yod pa las/ lan cig dus ston zhig la mi che ba lnga brgya tsam 'dus/

de re re la bstod pa gsar pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bstod dgos byung bas/ ji zhig nas tshig gsar pa sbyor ba'i blo gros gtugs te/ tshig sbyor snga ma rnams nyid/ slar bskyar te 'don pa spos nas glu blangs so/ /der tshig gsar pas bstod pa rnams kyis rngan pa che bar byin/ bskyar mas bstod pa rnams kyis zas nyung zad re tsam ma gtogs ma byin pas dus ston grol nas des bsams pa/ tshig gsar pa sbyor ba la thogs pa med pa'i thabs cig dgos pa 'dug snyam/ shing drung zhag tu ma no bsam gtong kyin yod tsa na/ rgyud yongs su grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig der byon nas khyod 'di ltar sem mam gsungs pas/ de mchog tu dad pa skyes nas de ltar lags kyi rjes su bzung bar zhu zhes zhabs la gtugs/ gsol ba btab pas rnal 'byor pa des/ bde mchog he ru ka'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyung ngu zhig byin no/ /de nas des kyang mtshan thog thag tu gnyid spangs te rtag tu sgom par byed cing*/ nyin par yang res 'ga' ni/ ngam grog dag tu yib kyin bsgom/ res 'ga' ni rang gi las kyi mtha' byed do/ /de nas lo mang dag song ba'i skabs zhig na/ lung stongs kyi lam 'ga' zhig na khyi mo zhig na nas 'chi la khad 'dug go /der spyang ki zhig 'ongs nas khyi de za la khad khad 'dug pa la/ thabs sna tshogs kyis bsrungs kyang mi thub pa ltar byung*/ khyi mo de'i srog srung ba'i phyir rang gi phyag g.yon pa bcad de spyang ki la byin pas de zos te spyang ki song ngo*/ /de nas yangs thabs cig la khyi mo med par rdo rje phag mor song nas/ phyag spyi bor bzhag cing bka'i gnang ba stsal ba tsam gyis grub pa thob/ de nas nags dang grong khyer kun tu glu kho na len cing skye bo mang po smin grol la bkod/ grub thob gā ya pa ste glu dbyangs mkhan du grags so/ /slob dpon nag po rdo rje ni yul ka liñdza ra te/

ka ling ka pa yin/ so ma pu rir slob gnyer byas te/ mkhas par song ba'i skabs shig grong khyer na byis pa mang po tshogs te/ gcig gis sgom byed pa ltar byed/ gzhan rnams kyis de la lkog gyur dris shing*/ des kyang de rnams la mngon shes lung ston gyi zlad mo byed kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ des rkyen byas te slob dpon gyis kyang*/ tshong khang na tshong pa rnams kyi sgrom dang rkyal pa rnams kyi nang na ci zhig yod ces blos brtags kyang ma shes nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs kyang phra mo 'di tsam yang mi shes pa snyam/ mkhas pa'i bya ba la thugs mug ste mtshan mo gsangs nas bros so/ /de nas kha sar pa ṇi la gsol ba 'debs kyin zla ba drug bzhugs/ rmi lam du/ 'di nas shar phyogs su phyin pa hi tsi li zhes pa'i grong khyer yod/ de'i nya pa'i grong na rdo rje phag mo bzhugs te/ der zhag bdun du gsol ba btab na zhal ston gsung*/ de bzhin du byas pas zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs cig /nya ba'i bud med rgan mo nya brgya phrag pa la bkal nas hral hral 'gro ba cig 'dug /de bcom ldan 'das mar shes nas zhabs la phyag byas te gsol ba btab pas/ bud med lang tsho ma cig tu gyur to/ /yang gsol ba btab pas sku dngos su gyur te me lce drag tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs nas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pas ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes skyes so/ /der sa dong byas nya ros mtha' bskor te/ rgyud sbyangs shing bsgoms pas dus gzhan zhig na grub pa brnyes so/ /slob dpon 'dis nya pa'i grong gi mgron khang cig tu bzhugs tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa'i gtso bo gsum 'khor rnal 'byor pa stong tsam dang bcas nas 'ong zhing 'dug /de rnams la 'dir byon tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzod byas pas/ slob dpon gsum po des slob dpon 'di bzhugs pa'i sgo nas ltas pas sha dum cig dang*/ nya dum cig dang chang bum chung cig las mi 'dug cing*/

gnas de yang dog por shes nas khyed kyis de rnams tshims par yang mi nus/ gnas 'dir yang mi shong ngo zer/ slob dpon na re/ ji tsam shong blta'o byas nas/ rnal 'byor pa stong phrag gcig nang der zhugs pas/ khyim gyi gra cig kyang ma khengs so/ /yo byad de rnams gtad nas khyed rnams kyis 'di longs spyod nus par gyis shig gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa de rnams kyis rdzas de las zhag bdun gyi bar du ji tsam zos shing 'thungs kyang ma zad do/ /de rnams kyis slob dpon nag po rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag byas/ bzod pa gsol te/ lhag ma za ma nus par bor te song ngo*/ /ka la haṃ sa ku mā ra ni grong khyer pa ṭa li pu trar 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus su zhing gi rka yur kho na 'tsho bar byed/ lus kha dog dkar ba zhig yod pas/ ka la ni zhing gi yur ba pa/ hang sa ni ngang pa ste dkar po/ ku mā ra gzhon nu ste de ltar grags/ de nas gtsug lag khang gcig tu rab tu byung zhing chos bslabs pas mkhas pa'i gral du chud tsam byung*/ da ni gzhan snying po med snyam ste/ bla ma cig la 'khor lo sdom pa zhus nas bsgoms pas/ nam zhig na nus pa khyad par can brnyes so/ /yul bhang ga la'i grong khyer cig na/ rgyal po cig gis sbyin bdag byas te/ bram ze lnga brgya tsam yod pa la re res thab gsum gsum byas te sbyin sreg mchod sbyin re re byed/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa yod pa la/ slob dpon 'dis dmigs pa brtad pas skad cig nyid la rlung dmar mi bzad pa langs nas/ mchod skong thams cad chag yo byad thams cad khyer ro/ /de ltar lan bdun brtsams pa las thams cad rlung gis khyer ba'i tha mal bram ze rnams dang*/ rgyal po rang yang rlung gis khyer zhing gos dang bral bar 'dug go /de nas rgyal po dang bram ze rnams slob dpon gyi mthu bstan par shes nas gus pas btud de/ bka' gnang zhus/ phyin chad srog bcad pa'i mchod sbyin mi byed cing*/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad par gyur to/ /slob dpon dharma pa ni yul lho phyogs dang nye ba'i grong khyer sā li pu drar 'khrungs/ yul der rab tu byung zhing*/ rig pa'i gnas rnams la mkhas par byas/ nyan bshad kyis dus 'das pa'i ngang la bgres shing spyan yang long*/ ci byar yang med pa'i skabs su yang dag pa'i lam dngos su ston nus pa'i bla ma zhig dang mjal na ci ma rung snyam zhing rtag tu dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ mnal lam du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma byon/ ngas byin gyis brlabs kyi gsung*/ de nas yang yang gsol ba btab pas dngos su byon nas byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pa gnang ngo*/ /de nas bsgoms pas lo lnga lon pa na/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud/ klog mkhan gyi tshul bzung nas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /mahā mā ya'i gzhung slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa zhig bdag gis kyang thos so/ /kuk+ku ṭi pa ni rig ma khyim bya'i gzugs su bsgyur ba cig yin/ guṇ+ḍi ri pa ni ghun+da ri pa zhes sngar bod na grags pa de yin par mngon/ bye'u ghuṇ+ḍi ri £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+dwags £©mang po bsad nas sha gsol/ yang gsos te zhal nas spur ba'i cho 'phrul bstan to/ /tsā ṭi la pa ni mtshan tsam ma gtogs lo rgyus cha ma 'tshal/ nā ḍi pa yang na ri pa gcig gam mi gcig brtag go /slob dpon gan+dha ra pa ste slob dpon sa 'dzin pa ni/ rigs rje rigs/ yul gan+dha ra ste sa 'dzin du 'khrungs/ mtshan dngos ni/ bidz+nyā naṃ ku ri zer/ dge bsnyen byas nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs par bslabs/ gsang sngags pa'i sde cig la zhugs/ de na sa 'dzin nas yongs pa'i mi gzhan med pas/ gan+dha ra pa zhes bla dwags su thogs/ slob dpon sgrub pa po purba gup+ta zhes pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor cig la 'khor lo sdom pa zhus nas bsgoms pas/ nam zhig na phra rags thams cad la gsal snang thob bo/ /des gser mgar gyi grong bya ba shar phyogs kyi grong khyer cig dang nye ba'i nags su bsgoms pas/

'bar snang gsal ba cig la dngos su me byung nas/ nags kyi rtswa dang shing thams cad mes tshig go /de nas mi ring bar char dbab po snyam/ ting nge 'dzin kho nas char phab ste sngar tshig pa rnams yud tsam gyis gsos so/ /der nus pa thob pas rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing yul sna tshogs su bzhud/ gling gaṃ ga sa ga ra nas/ grong khyer pra ya ga'i bar du/ chu bo gaṅgā la lpags gdan bting ste/ 'khor dang bcas pa yar 'byon mar 'byon mang po mdzad/ chu klung ro haṃ ta'am tshangs pa'i bu shin tu rgyas pa la'ang de bzhin du mdzad/ de nas lan cig gling dha na shrīr bzhud par bzhed nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa rgya mtsho'i steng nas mi bying bar bzhud pa na me tog gi char dang*/ sgra dang 'od dang dri bzang gis khyab pa dag byung ngo*/ /der slob dpon gan dha ra pas bsams pa/ da ni bdag bla ma dang nus pa mnyam mo bsams pa ni/ de ma thag chur bying ngo*/ /yang dad pa skyed pas sngar bzhin du gyur te gling dha na shrīr bzhud do/ /der yang sngags kyis 'gro ba'i don mang du mdzad/ nyi ma gcig la mchod rten brgya dang brgyad la rdo'i gdugs bkal lo/ /de nas slar yang ma ga dha dang nye ba/ dbang pos phug gi gnas su bzhugs/ dang po bla ma dang yon tan mnyam mo bsam pa'i nga rgyal byung ba'i rgyus/ sku lus ni gnas ma gyur/ nus pa khyad par can brnyes pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub la nye bar phyogs pa'o/ /bī na pa ni gzhan du bris zin/ taṇ+ḍe pa ni/ tan+ti pa dang gcig gam snyam/ tā ḍa ka pa ni/ chom po gcig phyis grub pa thob par grags/ grub thob kang kā la pa ni/ yul shar phyogs gau ra pa/ khyim bdag nor dang ldan pa cig 'dod yon la rtse zhing dga' bas gnas pa las/ glo bur du chung ma shi bar gyur te/ phung po dur khrod du bskyal ba'i tsa na mya ngan byed cing 'dug go /der legs par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig byon nas/

khyod ci byed gsung*/ des lo rgyus bshad sdug gtam byas pas/ 'di bas khyod nyid kyang 'chi na gsung*/ 'o na de las thar ba cig zhu byas pas des dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang de nas khyim bdag de dur khrod der 'dug nas/ sems kyi dri ma sbyong ba'i don du keng rus kyis mtha' bskor te bsgoms pas lo drug na dngos grub thob/ 'gro don yang rgya cher mdzad do/ /slob dpon dza ya nan di pa ni/ bram ze mkhas pa tshangs par spyod pa zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas dge bsnyen byas so/ /gsang sngags kyi slob dpon cig la gdams pa nod nas bsgoms/ yul ba ga la'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byed cing yod pa la/ des gtor ma'i bya ba yo byad dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ nyin re bzhin gtor ma btang bas blon po 'ga' zhig gis rgyal po la/ 'dis rgyal po'i longs spyod la 'phangs med byas zer zhing phra ma bcug pas/ rgyal pos slob dpon btson du bcug go /der bya rigs mi gcig pa thams cad 'dus/ 'dab chags 'bum phrag mang po pho brang der 'ongs nas/ sgra sna tshogs 'byin/ lus rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byed/ mi rnams kyi mgo la 'tshog par byed do/ /der bya skad shes pa zhig gis brtags pas/ nged rnams kyi pha ma btson du bzung ba yin/ khyed rnams zhag bdun nas rlag par byed do zer skad/ de rgyal po la zlos pas/ rgyal pos kyang btson khang gi khar 'ongs nas/ slob dpon la gtam dris pas/ slob dpon na re/ ngas rgyal po'i yo byad nas rang 'tshams kyis blangs nas btang ba med gsung*/ 'o na de tsam gang las rnyed byas pas phyag nam mkha' la g.yabs pa tsam gyis 'bru dang zan dang dar ras sogs dpag tu med pa mdun du phung phung byung*/ de nas slob dpon de grub pa thob par shes nas/ rgyal pos zhabs la gtugs/ pho brang du spyan drangs te/ mchod do/ /de gong yon tan sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du mdzad/ de nas brtsams te grub thob tu grags so/

/chos 'khor bi kra ma shī la'i ba ling ā tsar+ya te gtor ma'i slob dpon thog ma rang mtshan klu sgrub snying por grags pa gtor ma'i cho ga kun las btus pa mdzad pa po de yang*/ grub thob dza ya nan di pa 'di'i slob ma yin no/ /slob dpon bha de pa ni/ ma ga dha'i phyogs gcig gnas chung gcig gi gnyer byed pa'i gnas brtan yin/ chos kyang ci ris shes pa gcig yin pa la/ lan cig dge slong dur khrod pa zhig la brda gtong ba'i phyir dur khrod du phyin/ der mang ngo'i bcu bzhi yin pas/ grong khyer nas 'ongs pa'i mchod pa byed mkhan mang du 'dug gzhan rnams mchod pa zin nas sngon la log /bud med dar yol cig mchod pa'i bya ba la thogs nas rjes la lus/ de ni sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo lan gsum zer nas/ rkang pa khru gang tsam sa la ma reg par yer kyis song tsa na/ gzhan rnams las chod chad kyi song bar grong khyer du sleb song ba mthong*/ da dus rjes ma zin yang slar de btsal bas rnyed/ sprul pa'i skur shes nas zhabs la gtugs shing gsol ba btab pas/ des ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal/ bha de bas gnas brtan gyi bya ba bor nas/ res 'ga' ni dur khrod du bsgom/ res 'ga' ni gtsug lag khang du bsgom/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis tsam song ba na/ lan cig dur khrod du mi mang pos song ba na/ keng rus chos gos gon pa zhig tu mi rnams kyis mthong skad/ gtsug lag khang du'ang de ltar mthong ba lan mang du byung*/ nang du dngos grub khyad par can brnyes/ phyi rol tu keng rus dang*/ mi thod bya ril gyi cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ phyis 'ja' lus su gshegs/ 'dis kyang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim dang dbang chog gi gzhung la sogs pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang grub thob bi dhi badz+ra zhes bya ba 'khor rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya tsam dang bcas te rtag tu tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la spyod pa zhig byung*/

'khor lnga brgya po re res kyang thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub/ gzhan yang slob tshogs mang*/ 'dis 'gro lding du byon te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bsdus pa'i don dang*/ rnam par bshad pa la sogs pa mdzad/ gnas der 'ja' lus su gshegs par grags/ 'di'i srol ka rgya gar du ring du ma dar/ 'gro lding na da lta'i bar du yang yod par 'dug 'di dang bram ze ye shes rdo rje ste ye shes zhabs su grags pa gnyis car dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma nas lung bstan to/ /yang rnal 'byor pa ma tri dad ta zhes bya ba/ rigs ni bram ze/ rten ni dge bsnyen/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la rnam 'byor du byed pa cig lan cig lung bstan byung ste dur khrod du bzhud/ rang gi blo sbyang ba'i don du/ mi ro la la gdan du bting*/ la la sngas su btsug /la la phyogs phyogs su ka ba'i tshul du btsugs/ la las steng nas thog phub pa'i tshul byas te bzhugs/ de ltar mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud do/ /shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa mdzad pa cig yin/ dus de tsam na o ḍi bi sha'i yul gyi phyogs cig tu/ mtsho gsar pa brdol/ klu gdug pa can gsar du skyes pa zhig byung ste/ des grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo gtsang ma dag rkus te rang gnas su 'khyer ro/ /lan cig rgyal po bī ra pā la zhes bya ba'i bu gcig kyang klus khyer te stor bas/ rgyal pos slob dpon de la gsol ba btabs/ slob dpon gyis mtsho'i nang du song*/ klu'i gnas su byon te rgyal po'i bu blangs te slar rgyal po nyid la gtad do/ /der thams cad kyi grub pa thob par shes nas/ klu de 'dul bar zhus/ slob dpon gyis thugs brtad pas mtsho de khol/ sngar khye'u bu mo rkus pa thams cad kyang ma shi ba nyid du thon nas/ rang rang gi pha ma sogs la gtad pas dga' ba skyes/

'di la grub thob ma sā na pa zer/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa ste phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sbyor drug bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa yin/ 'dis sems 'grel gyi kha skong yang mdzad/ chos rgyun yang ci rigs par byung ngo*/ /dā ri ka pa nas de'i bar gyi slob dpon de rnams kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam shin tu mang ba zhig yod 'dug na'ang*/ bdag gis mthong thos su gyur pa ni/ gzhan du bris pa dang*/ 'dir ni bris pa de tsam mo/ /de bzhin du tsar+ya pa'i sde rigs su chad pa la/ grub thob hi ra ṇ+ya pa dang*/ man+da ra pa dang*/ ti la ka pa dang*/ su dar sha pa dang*/ tsi trā tsa pa dang*/ karka ra pa dang*/ dza du kar+ṇa dang*/ dha na mi tra dang*/ slob dpon dzi mu ta pa dang*/ dharma shrī dang*/ a dzi ta badz+ra dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa ga yi pa dang*/ li la badz+ra dang*/ sa ri ta pa la sogs pa bstan bcos kyang ci rigs pa mdzad cing*/ nus pa thob pa'i grags chen mang du byung la/ phyis rang yang na go pa dang*/ sa dhā ri pa sogs nus mthu chen po thob pa dag byung ngo*/ /tsar+ya pa rnams phal cher 'khor lo sdom pa la zhugs pa mang*/ dgyes rdor dang*/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ gzhan sgrub thabs phra mo la brten nas/ nag po chen po dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rigs grub pa yang mang du byung*/ thams cad kyang dpyid kyi thig le dang*/ rlung gi rnal 'byor la gtso bor byed pa sha stag go /slob dpon an tar pa yan chad du/ spyod pa pa'i slob rgyud mang pos sa steng khyab kyang*/ tsar+ya pa'i sde rigs su chad pa med/ slob dpon spyod chung ba'i dus su spyod pa par grags pa'i sde byung*/ de nas bhu ba ri pa dang*/ bhu ba blo ldan gyi dus la'ang cung zad 'phel/ de rjes slob dpon ku sa la pas gzhan gyi 'dres dang bsre bslad spangs/ gzhung man ngag rnams la dag ster dang*/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi sgrigs bkod sogs/
